defaultPains.wasted_spend: Most home service businesses waste 25-40% of their Google Ads budget on irrelevant searches. Generic keywords like 'repair near me' attract clicks from people outside your service area or looking for DIY solutions.
defaultPains.negatives: Without a proper negative keyword list, your ads show for searches like 'how to fix' and 'DIY' — people who will never hire you but happily drain your budget.
defaultPains.geo: If your geo-targeting isn't tight, you're paying for clicks from people 30+ miles away who will never become customers.
defaultPains.tracking: Without conversion tracking, you can't measure what's working. Most home service businesses track clicks, not calls — and 70% of leads come by phone.
defaultPains.scheduling: Running ads 24/7 when you only answer phones 8am-6pm means paying for calls that go to voicemail. Voicemail leads convert at less than 10%.
defaultPains.bidding: Automated bidding without enough conversion data makes poor decisions. You need 30+ conversions per month before Smart Bidding works reliably.

defaultPains.wasted_spend: Healthcare advertising faces strict compliance requirements and high CPCs. Without proper campaign structure, practices waste 30-50% of spend on non-converting terms.
defaultPains.negatives: Medical terms attract informational searches. Someone searching 'what is a root canal' costs you $5-15 per click but has zero intent to book an appointment.
defaultPains.geo: Patients typically travel 10-15 minutes for routine care. If your radius is set to 25 miles, you're paying for patients who will never make the drive.
defaultPains.tracking: Most healthcare leads are phone calls. Without call tracking, you can't measure which keywords drive actual appointments vs. which drive insurance questions.
defaultPains.scheduling: After-hours clicks for non-emergency practices are wasted budget. Align your ad schedule with your front desk hours.
defaultPains.bidding: Healthcare CPCs range from $5-50. Without conversion data, automated bidding burns through budgets on high-CPC terms that don't convert.

defaultPains.wasted_spend: Pet service businesses often target overly broad terms. 'Pet care' could mean grooming, boarding, training, or veterinary — each with different conversion values.
defaultPains.negatives: Without negative keywords, you show up for 'free pet adoption' and 'pet insurance' searches that will never convert to your services.
defaultPains.geo: Pet owners choose providers close to home or work. A 20-mile radius in urban areas means paying for clicks from pet owners who have 5 closer options.
defaultPains.tracking: Most pet service bookings happen by phone. If you're only tracking form submissions, you're missing 60-70% of your actual leads.
defaultPains.scheduling: Pet services are booked during business hours. Weekend ads can work for boarding searches, but weekday evenings are typically wasted spend.
defaultPains.bidding: Pet service CPCs are moderate ($3-15) but competition is growing fast. Manual bidding lets you pay less during low-intent hours.

defaultPains.wasted_spend: Auto repair shops waste budget on brand-specific searches they can't serve and on 'how to' DIY searches that never convert to shop visits.
defaultPains.negatives: Car make and model searches attract browsers and DIY mechanics. 'Honda Civic brake pads' is someone shopping on Amazon, not looking for a shop.
defaultPains.geo: Drivers choose repair shops within 5-10 minutes of home or work. A 15-mile radius in a metro area is paying for unreachable customers.
defaultPains.tracking: Auto repair customers call to book. Without call tracking tied to keywords, you can't tell if your $8 brake pad click or your $25 transmission click drove the appointment.
defaultPains.scheduling: Most auto repair appointments are booked Monday-Friday 7am-5pm. Weekend ad spend targets people who are less likely to book immediately.
defaultPains.bidding: Emergency searches (car won't start, flat tire) command premium CPCs but convert at 25%+. Budget accordingly.

defaultPains.wasted_spend: Legal advertising has some of the highest CPCs in Google Ads ($50-200+). A single poorly targeted campaign can waste thousands in days.
defaultPains.negatives: Legal searches are rife with informational intent. 'What is personal injury' and 'can I sue' are research queries, not client acquisition opportunities.
defaultPains.geo: Practice areas have different geographic considerations. Personal injury is local; immigration or patent law can be national. Match your geo to your practice.
defaultPains.tracking: Law firm leads are phone calls and form fills. Without tracking both, and attributing them to specific practice areas, you're flying blind.
defaultPains.scheduling: Legal consultations are typically booked during business hours. After-hours emergency searches exist but are rare outside criminal defense.
defaultPains.bidding: At $50-200+ per click, every wasted click is painful. Precise match types and robust negative lists are essential to survival.
